items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1964-04-25
items.q: I had that same band when we was kids. One of us kids, yeah. Same band.

ctx.x: I had that same band when we was kids. One of us kids, yeah. Same band. Same band as when you were kids? Yeah. Who was that? Playing piccoloos and stuff like that. Oh, yeah. When he killed Steve Hennessy, when he went and got them dagos out of prison, you mean? Yeah. And lynched them. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.

Young sir, regular young sir, Ed. Mm-hmm. Papa, I want to ask you about that political meeting again. Did you have a name for your band when you played that political meeting? No, just Lane's Band, that's all. Lane's Band. We call it Lane's Band.
We wasn't married by that Dave.
